chapter: Buddy Petit and Sam Morgan years
title: Henry Martin's band at the Bungalow and Ory
summary: Williams recalls Henry Martin playing for years at the Bungalow while also playing with Ory, and who else played out there.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Okay, let's see this is real too Alfred Williams, October the 13th 1961. You were telling me about Henry Martin too, he played out at the bungalow?
He played out at the bungalow for many years.
And who was that? Do you know who was in there? Who had the band?
He was playing with Ory too at that time, you know, when he was playing out there.
I just remember who was playing with him. I don't know who had the band, did you hear? No, I don't remember all that.

Now Pete could tell you, yeah, he could tell you just who was playing out there. But he used to lay off from there on Sunday night, Saturday, Sunday, or Monday night, and play with Ory. See, he played with that band and played with Ory's band at that time, and I knew of him, you know, see. That was around 1917, 1918. Frankie Dewson played out there a good while, and I don't know whether he was playing with Frankie Dewson or not. See, he could have been. Frankie played with the manager of the band out there.
It must have been the Eagle or something.
Oh, they didn't go by that name, I imagine not, because we mixed up fellas, you know. Yeah. Yeah, like I'd say, come on Dick, you come play, you want a job, this fella and that fella, yeah. Oh yeah.
